chunks: Allah, Mighty and Majestic: “And those who believe and do not mix their faith with ظلم (injustice).”
He said: “It means with what Muḥammad صلى الله عليه وآله came with of the wilayah, and that they do not mix it with the wilayah of so-and-so and so-and-so; then that is the one mixed with injustice.”

key_terms.الْمُلَبَّسُ: that which is mixed or confounded
key_terms.الْوَلَايَةِ: wilayah; divinely ordained authority and allegiance
key_terms.بِظُلْمٍ: with injustice; here, mixing faith with what does not rightfully belong with it

ai.seo_question: How is Qur'an 6:82 interpreted in relation to wilayah in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This report explains the verse as referring to faith joined with acceptance of the wilayah brought by Muḥammad صلى الله عليه وآله. It states that faith is not to be mixed with the wilayah of others, and that such mixing is described as ظلم (injustice).
